domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with normalization, denominator alignment, regrouping, and simplification

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number, mixed number, or fraction into an equivalent subtraction-ready form without changing denominator relationships, such as adding a zero fractional part, simplifying a fractional part within a mixed number, or converting an improper mixed-number part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed number with a zero fractional part, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a fractional part inside a mixed number is simplified before subtraction, such as 3 4/10 to 3 2/5.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step's main purpose is to create equivalent fractions with a common denominator; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping during subtraction; that belongs to S04.
Do not tag direct subtraction or final simplification/combining after subtraction.

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Create equivalent fractions with a common denominator so fractional parts can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike fractions.
Tag when one or both fractions are rewritten as equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when mixed-number fraction parts are converted to a shared denominator before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-fraction conversion is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d or normalizing an improper mixed-number part; those belong to S01.
Do not tag subtraction, borrowing, or final simplification steps.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with common denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately after any needed preparation.
Tag when the main subtraction is carried out directly and no regrouping step is being performed in that same step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to normalize operands or create common denominators.
Do not tag borrowing a whole into fractional units; that belongs to S04.
Do not tag simplification-only or final expression-only steps after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Regroup or simplify
skills.definition: Borrow one whole into fractional units when needed and/or reduce the resulting answer to lowest terms or an appropriate whole-number or mixed-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is borrowed from the whole-number part and converted into denominator-sized fractional units to continue subtraction.
Tag when a resulting fraction or zero fraction is simplified, such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when the final result is expressed appropriately as a whole number or mixed number after subtraction, especially when this follows regrouping or simplification.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary direct subtraction when no regrouping or simplification is involved; that belongs to S03.
Do not tag initial rewriting of operands into subtraction-ready form; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion before subtraction; that belongs to S02.
